scope_basis: verified local admissible cache 2024-04..09 (>=5 sym, >=3 non-overlapping 30d blocks)

design_freeze.splits: chronological walk-forward or fixed train/val/test boundaries by coverage; purge/embargo >= max forward horizon (>=168h); train-only normalization; no holdout outcome inspection.
design_freeze.features: Gate 4 ablations A_rv_only/B_rv_signed/C_rv_abs/D_rv_signed_abs/E_rv_funding_trails; funding at/before prediction time; training-only normalization.
design_freeze.targets: primary forward realized volatility/variance per frozen definition; secondary horizons pre-registered
design_freeze.metrics: QLIKE primary; MAE/RMSE; block bootstrap CIs; Holm correction across pre-registered family
design_freeze.stop_rule: stop on unresolved leakage/provenance/license defect, failed guard, insufficient sample/blocks/instruments, or failed completeness audit; preserve NOT_SUPPORTED/INCONCLUSIVE/NO_GO; no threshold shopping.

hard_blockers: human/legal terms unresolved (v5) - do not freeze/promote while all_go=false
promotion_requirements: human/legal reviewer provides verifiable resolved terms evidence (RESOLVED_VERIFIED, fabricated=false)
freeze before any outcome inspection with explicit freeze commit hash
fresh frozen prereg ID before confirmatory outcomes
